notes.title: CozySudoku 1.4.0 - Stamp Fill Mode
notes.content:
- Fixed the bug where undo caused pencil marks to appear in cells 
- Enhanced number outlines for identical numbers to make them more prominent 
- Added a new feature: "Stamp Fill." In stamp mode, you can select a number first and then a cell to fill it. The shortcut for stamp mode is the S key
- Modified storage format to fix save parsing issues

notes.title: Cozy Sudoku Update Version 0.1.2.2
notes.content:
Cozy Sudoku Update Version 0.1.2.2

[list]
[*] Added the ability to move the selected cell using the keyboard arrow keys.
[*] Added number selection using the numpad.
[*] Fixed an issue where toggling the music setting would cause a volume change error.
[*] Fixed the color display error of the same number in the peer area.
[*] Modified the display issue for Chinese, Japanese, and Korean on dates.
[*] Fixed the conflict between the F12 debug function and Steam's screenshot key.
[/list]

notes.title: Support keyboard input
notes.content:
Support keyboard input:

[list]
[*] 1~9 Keys - Fill in numbers in the current grid
[*] N Key - Active/Disable Note
[*] Back Key - Undo
[*] Del Key - Clear Number
[/list]

tags.feature: [*] 1~9 Keys - Fill in numbers in the current grid
